abstract: BACKGROUND: Primary seminomas of the mediastinum are unusual neoplasms that are morphologically indistinguishable from their gonadal counterparts but may have different biologic behavior because they arise at this particular location. METHODS: The clinical and pathologic features in 120 cases of primary mediastinal seminoma were reviewed, and the immunohistochemical staining patterns in 50 of these tumors were also analyzed. RESULTS: The patients were all men between the ages of 14 and 79 years (mean age, 46.5 years). Their clinical symptoms included cough, chest pain, and dyspnea. In some patients, the lesions were asymptomatic and discovered incidentally on routine chest radiographs. None of the patients had a previous history of testicular neoplasm or tumor elsewhere. Macroscopically, the tumors were described as soft and tan, with a slightly lobulated cut surface, and measured up to 16 cm in greatest dimension. Histologically, the morphologic features were similar to those of tumors occurring in the gonads, namely, a neoplastic proliferation of round-to-polygonal cells with indistinct cell borders, clear-to-lightly-eosinophilic cytoplasm with round-to-oval nuclei and prominent nucleoli, associated with a prominent inflammatory background composed mainly of mature lymphocytes. Necrosis, hemorrhage, multinucleated giant cells, granulomatous reaction, and remnants of thymic tissue were observed in a variable number of cases; mitoses were rare. Immunohistochemical studies in 50 cases showed cytoplasmic staining with placental alkaline phosphatase in 80% of the tumors, focal dotlike positivity for CAM 5.2 low-molecular-weight keratins in 75%, focal cytoplasmic staining for wide-spectrum keratin in 70%, focal positive reaction with vimentin in 70%, and focal positivity with HCG in singly scattered cells in 5%. Immunostains for carcinoembryonic antigen, epithelial membrane antigen, and alpha-fetoprotein were negative in all the cases studied. Fifty patients were Stage I, 3 patients were Stage II, and 12 patients were Stage III. Clinical follow-up information was obtained for 65 cases (54%). Forty-nine patients were alive and disease free after a period ranging from 1 to 19 years (mean follow-up, 10 years). Sixteen patients died within the same period and were found to have metastases to distant organs. Of the 16 patients who died, 6 showed extension of the tumor outside of the mediastinal compartment at the time of initial diagnosis (Stage III lesions). Aside from clinical staging, the authors' findings also suggest that patients >37 years have worse outcomes than younger individuals. The authors were unable to find any correlation between histopathologic features and clinical behavior in any of these cases. CONCLUSIONS: Clinical and pathologic staging of mediastinal seminomas are important parameters that can be useful in determining the clinical outcomes of patients with these tumors. Tumor invasion into adjacent organs represents a marker of increased morbidity and mortality. The authors' findings suggest that patients with mediastinal seminomas may have a very good prognosis when the diagnosis is made early; patients with more advanced lesions may require more aggressive therapy for improved local control and prevention of distant metastases.
abstract_ja: 背景：原発性縦隔セミノーマは稀な腫瘍であり、形態学的には性腺の対応腫瘍と区別できないが、発生部位が異なるため生物学的挙動が異なる可能性がある。方法：原発性縦隔セミノーマ120例の臨床的・病理学的特徴を検討し、そのうち50例で免疫組織化学的染色パターンを解析した。結果：患者は全員男性で、年齢は14〜79歳(平均46.5歳)であった。臨床症状として咳嗽、胸痛、呼吸困難がみられた。無症状で、胸部X線検査で偶然発見された例もあった。精巣腫瘍や他部位の腫瘍の既往を有する患者はいなかった。肉眼的には、腫瘍は柔らかく淡黄褐色で、割面はわずかに分葉状であり、最大径は16cmに達していた。組織学的には、性腺に発生する腫瘍と類似した形態を示し、境界が不明瞭な細胞質を持つ円形から多角形の腫瘍細胞の増殖が認められた。細胞質は淡明からやや好酸性で、円形から卵円形の核と目立つ核小体を有していた。これらは、主として成熟リンパ球からなる目立つ炎症性背景を伴っていた。壊死、出血、多核巨細胞、肉芽腫反応、および胸腺組織の遺残が、さまざまな頻度で認められた。核分裂像はまれであった。免疫組織化学的検討(50例)では、80%の腫瘍で胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼの細胞質染色が陽性、75%でCAM 5.2低分子量ケラチンの点状陽性、70%で広域スペクトラムケラチンの細胞質染色、70%でビメンチンの限局陽性、5%で散在する単一細胞にhCGの陽性がみられた。癌胎児性抗原、上皮膜抗原、αフェトプロテインの免疫染色は、検討したすべての症例で陰性であった。病期は、病期I 50例、病期II 3例、病期III 12例であった。臨床経過の情報は65例(54%)で得られた。49例は1〜19年(平均追跡期間10年)にわたり生存し無病であった。16例は同期間内に死亡し、遠隔臓器への転移が確認されていた。死亡した16例のうち6例は、初診時に縦隔区画外への腫瘍の進展を示していた(病期III病変)。臨床病期分類以外にも、著者らの知見では、37歳を超える患者は若年者よりも予後不良であることが示唆された。組織学的所見と臨床的挙動との間の相関は、いずれの症例でも見いだせなかった。結論：縦隔セミノーマの臨床的および病理学的病期分類は、患者の臨床転帰を予測するうえで有用な重要なパラメータである。隣接臓器への腫瘍浸潤は、罹患率と死亡率の増加の指標となる。著者らの知見は、縦隔セミノーマ患者が診断早期に治療されれば非常に良好な予後を示す可能性があることを示唆している。より進行した病変を有する患者では、局所制御の改善と遠隔転移の予防のために、より積極的な治療が必要となる可能性がある。
